name: Mechs vs Kaiju's Ragdoll | [MAJOR UPDATE]
desc:
MAJOR UPDATE: THE JUNGLE IS HERE! Thank you for 9K active and 5 MILLION visits!

NEW CODES (ROBUX SHOP - like + favorite + join our group to use them):
JUNGLE, NEWMAP, KAIJUS, 9KACTIVE, 5MVISITS, SECRET

Kaiju are coming out of the sea. Stop them!

Pilot a giant ragdoll mech and fight monster waves with real physics. Punch, grab, rip and smash kaiju through buildings.

NEW IN THIS UPDATE
- NEW MAP: THE JUNGLE - snakes, tree monsters, Stone Guardians and the Ravager (+20% scrap)
- JUNGLE SKINS: fight in the jungle and your mech grows its own moss, vines and rust
- NEW SECRET RARITY: a hidden mech is in the packs... can you get him?
- AUTO ROLL, pick up your torn-off arm with T, Titan throws buildings, less lag and lots of fixes

MECHS: Cipsy Dagger, Coyote Tangle, Black Alpha, Red Tsunami, Bravo Guardian, Titan, Ripper, Scorpion, Agility, Mace and more.

Squad up with friends, open mech packs and unlock wave checkpoints. Works on PC, phone and console.

Made by Jadyboy467 & EZMON107.

llm.loop: pilot a ragdoll mech -> fight waves of kaiju with physics punches/grabs/throws in a destructible city -> earn scrap -> open mech packs and unlock wave checkpoints
llm.objectives: stop kaiju waves, reach later wave checkpoints, unlock more mechs
llm.progression: mech roster from packs, scrap, wave checkpoints
llm.instructions: pilot a giant ragdoll mech, punch/grab/throw kaiju through buildings, squad up with friends, earn scrap and open mech packs; redeem codes in the Robux shop
unique: physics-driven ragdoll mech vs kaiju brawling with full city destruction
Pacific Rim-style named mechs with distinct move sets
monetization_signals: Robux packs (in-game currency) and giftable packs
llm.thumbnails: icon red mech vs blue kaiju 'VS' split; thumbnails show red ragdoll mech firing beams at kaiju in neon city, DRILL UPDATE banner
llm.video: 1 video on page, content not shown
llm.complexity_notes: physics ragdoll mechs with many unique movesets, destructible city, kaiju AI waves, per-match servers; substantial physics and animation work
